title: Singleton coefficient of a Hamming upper tail
statement: For every real threshold $t$, natural number $m$, and coordinate $i<m+1$, let $R(x)=(m+1)^{-1/2}\sum_{j=0}^{m}x_j$ on the sign cube of dimension $m+1$, and let $H(x)=1$ if $R(x)>t$ and $H(x)=0$ otherwise. The Fourier coefficient of $H$ at $i$ equals $\mathbb{E}[H(x)R(x)]/\sqrt{m+1}$, with expectation under the uniform measure on that cube.
